title: Interface lemmas expose PCUIC lift_typing to bidirectional-checker clients
intent: Close the abstraction boundary between the bidirectional checker's `checking`/`infering_sort` relations and PCUIC's `typing`/`lift_typing`: the parent `lift_sorting_lift_typing` assembles four already-proved interface lemmas into one theorem that turns any bidirectional sorting judgment into a PCUIC `lift_typing` fact, so clients read off PCUIC facts without unfolding the checker.

parent.name: lift_sorting_lift_typing
parent.statement:
Theorem lift_sorting_lift_typing `{cf : checker_flags} (Σ : global_env_ext) Γ j (wfΣ : wf Σ) :
  wf_local Σ Γ -> lift_sorting (checking Σ Γ) (infering_sort Σ Γ) j -> lift_typing typing Σ Γ j.

children.name: lift_sorting_it_impl
children.statement:
Lemma lift_sorting_it_impl {Pc Qc Ps Qs} {j} :
    forall tu: lift_sorting Pc Ps j,
    let s := tu.2.π1 in
    option_default (fun tm => Pc tm (j_typ j) -> Qc tm (j_typ j)) (j_term j) unit ->
    (Ps (j_typ j) s -> Qs (j_typ j) s) ->
    lift_sorting Qc Qs j.
children.closed_by: relativize (lift_sorting Qc Qs j); 1: apply lift_sorting_f_it_impl with (f := id); destruct j, j_term => //
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: A generic lifting lemma that turns a lift_sorting for Pc/Ps into one for Qc/Qs from componentwise implications.

children.name: infering_sort_typing
children.statement:
Theorem infering_sort_typing `{checker_flags} (Σ : global_env_ext) Γ t u (wfΣ : wf Σ) :
  wf_local Σ Γ -> Σ ;;; Γ |- t ▹□ u -> Σ ;;; Γ |- t : tSort u.
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: Bidirectional sort inference implies PCUIC typing at the inferred sort.

children.name: checking_typing
children.statement:
Theorem checking_typing `{checker_flags} (Σ : global_env_ext) Γ t T (wfΣ : wf Σ) :
  wf_local Σ Γ -> isType Σ Γ T -> Σ ;;; Γ |- t ◃ T -> Σ ;;; Γ |- t : T.
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: Bidirectional checking against a well-typed type implies PCUIC typing.

children.name: isTypebd_isType
children.statement:
Theorem isTypebd_isType `{checker_flags} (Σ : global_env_ext) Γ j (wfΣ : wf Σ) :
  wf_local Σ Γ -> lift_sorting (checking Σ Γ) (infering_sort Σ Γ) j -> isType Σ Γ (j_typ j).
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: A bidirectional sorting judgment yields a PCUIC isType of the judgment's type.

applicability.goal_shape: A goal whose conclusion is a PCUIC judgment (`lift_typing typing Σ Γ j`, or a component `Σ ;;; Γ |- t : T` / `isType Σ Γ t`) and whose hypotheses are the algorithmic bidirectional judgments (`lift_sorting (checking Σ Γ) (infering_sort Σ Γ) j`, `Σ ;;; Γ |- t ▹□ u`, `Σ ;;; Γ |- t ◃ T`).
applicability.use_when: A development defines its own algorithmic relation (here the mutual inductive `checking`/`infering_sort` of BDTyping.v) and wants a one-shot bridge to the semantic relation (`typing`/`lift_typing`), with the componentwise implications already proved separately; clients should consume the semantic facts without unfolding the algorithmic definitions.
applicability.avoid_when: The bridge itself is the hard content — here that work lives in `bidirectional_to_pcuic` (BDToPCUIC.v line 206), proved by mutual induction, not in the thin glue; when clients genuinely need the algorithmic structure rather than the semantic conclusion; when there is no single generic lifting lemma (`lift_sorting_it_impl`) to carry the componentwise implications, so each component would need its own ad-hoc glue.

consequences: The move relies on the componentwise implications already existing: `lift_sorting_it_impl` needs a `Pc -> Qc` and a `Ps -> Qs` implication, and here `checking_typing` additionally needs an `isType Σ Γ (j_typ j)` well-formedness hypothesis, which the glue discharges with `isTypebd_isType`. If a client calls `checking_typing` directly they must supply that `isType` obligation themselves; the parent hides it by deriving it from the bidirectional judgment. A failure mode is applying `lift_sorting_it_impl` when the `Ps -> Qs` side is not available for all sorts, in which case the `2:` branch of the parent's `apply` would not close.
